headline: Celebrity impersonators fill the frame in DEEPFAKE: what does it mean to be seen? – in pictures
context: Cybele Malinowski has spent 20 years photographing the icons of contemporary culture. Shot over two years in Las Vegas and Los Angeles, DEEPFAKE is what happens when she turns that camera on the people who have chosen to become someone else entirely. The exhibit is on until 6 Sep

sources.name: The Guardian
